Namaz Vakitleri Tabloları

Prayer times for Ankara are updated daily by the Presidency of Religious Affairs (Diyanet) based on astronomical calculations and Islamic jurisprudence. Today (8 Cemaziyelahir 1448), the Fajr time for Ankara is 06:02, sunrise is at 07:28, Dhuhr is at 12:38, Asr is at 15:15, Maghrib is at 17:39, and Isha is at 19:00. The qibla angle for Ankara is 155 degrees.

Read More

On this page you can view not only today's times but also weekly, monthly, and yearly prayer time tables for Ankara, letting you check upcoming days and months in advance. These times are calculated specifically for Ankara based on the sun's actual position in the sky. You can also follow Ankara prayer times through the Presidency of Religious Affairs' official mobile app and set up adhan notifications on your device.
